name: Employee Payroll Data (FMPS Payroll Costing)
rowLabel: Employee Pay Element in a Payroll Period

Metadata.Frequency: Updated multiple times per year, as data is available. Typically 4 times per year (every 6 Pay Periods).  See "tutorial" link to learn how to set up notifications for when this dataset is updated.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Amounts include Debits and Credits, and may include negative dollar amounts.

columns.name: FUND TYPE
columns.description: Fund Type is associated with the Fund Code, as designated in the Budget Ordinance (specifically Summary E) and aligning with the City's financial management systems.

columns.name: FUND
columns.description: Code and description associated with the Fund as designated in the Budget Ordinance and aligning with the City's financial management systems.

columns.name: DEPARTMENT FUNCTION
columns.description: Department Function is defined by Department (Code) and aligns with the Budget Ordinance (specifically Summary E).

columns.name: DEPARTMENT
columns.description: Code and description associated with the City department as designated in the Budget Ordinance and aligning with the City's financial management systems.

columns.name: APPROPRIATION
columns.description: Code and description associated with the Appropriation as designated in the Budget Ordinance and aligning with the City's financial management systems.

columns.name: TITLE
columns.description: Code and description associated with employee's job title as designated in the Budget Ordinance and aligning with the City's financial management system.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE DATASET ID
columns.description: This Employee Dataset identifier has been created exclusively for this dataset.  This Employee ID does not match any official city system (such as FMPS, CHIPPS).

columns.name: EMPLOYEE
columns.description: This field combines Employee Dataset ID (CODE) and Employee (Name) to enhance usability of this dataset.

columns.name: PAY ELEMENT
columns.description: Pay Element is a function of the CIty's FMPS Payroll Costing module and a part of the financial process.  This object is not defined in the City's Budget Ordinance.

columns.name: PAYROLL YEAR
columns.description: This is the year associated with the Payroll Period.  This is in alignment with the Payroll Costing module of FMPS.

columns.name: PAYROLL PERIOD
columns.description: Payroll Period as a Number (1-24) for improved dataset usability.

columns.name: DEPARTMENT CODE
columns.description: Code associated with the City department as designated in the Budget Ordinance and aligning with the City's financial management systems.

columns.name: FUND CODE
columns.description: Code associated with the Fund as designated in the Budget Ordinance and aligning with the City's financial management systems.

columns.name: APPROPRIATION CODE
columns.description: Code associated with the Appropriation as designated in the Budget Ordinance and aligning with the City's financial management systems.

columns.name: TITLE CODE
columns.description: Code associated with the job title as designated in the Budget Ordinance and aligning with the City's financial management systems.

columns.name: RECORD ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for the record. This column is primarily used for purposes of maintaining this dataset. It will be unique at any given time but users should not rely on any other aspects remaining stable.
